name: Local Volume galaxies (UNGC, with McConnachie 2012 Local Group values)

sources.citation: Karachentsev, I. D., Makarov, D. I., & Kaisina, E. I. 2013, AJ, 145, 101, "Updated Nearby Galaxy Catalog"
McConnachie, A. W. 2012, AJ, 144, 4, "The Observed Properties of Dwarf Galaxies in and around the Local Group"
Skrutskie, M. F., Cutri, R. M., Stiening, R., et al. 2006, AJ, 131, 1163, "The Two Micron All Sky Survey (2MASS)"; Jarrett, T. H., et al. 2000, AJ, 119, 2498 (Extended Source Catalog)
sources.usedFor: paDeg where paSource = 2MASX (joined through the 2MRS duplicate, see 2mrs-manifest.json)

selection: UNGC (869 galaxies: individual distances within ~11 Mpc or V_LG < 600 km/s) minus the Milky Way, plus McConnachie 2012 galaxies absent from UNGC. McConnachie distances (from (m-M)_0), positions, M_V, radial velocities and position angles replace UNGC values for matched galaxies within 3 Mpc; UNGC distance-dependent quantities (MB, logLK, diamKpc) are rescaled to the adopted distance. Rows are sorted by distance.

derivations.distMpc: 10^((m-M)_0/5 + 1) pc; UNGC table1 Dist (rounded to 0.01 Mpc) is replaced by its table6 distance modulus when consistent
derivations.MB: UNGC table2 BMag - 5 log10(D_adopted/D_UNGC); if absent: Bmag - A_B - A_B,int - 5 log10(D/10 pc)
derivations.lum: 10^(-0.4 (MV - 4.83)) when McConnachie M_V exists, else LB
derivations.logLK: UNGC table2 logL_K + 2 log10(D_adopted/D_UNGC); if absent: 0.4 (3.28 - (Ks - 0.085 (A_B + A_B,int) - 5 log10(D/10 pc)))
derivations.diamKpc: UNGC table2 A26 * D_adopted/D_UNGC; if absent: D * a26 (arcmin -> rad)

fieldNotes.name: catalog designation (UNGC Name; McConnachie Name for M12-only rows)
fieldNotes.displayName: human-friendly name (McConnachie name when matched, else the UNGC designation with padding removed)
fieldNotes.altNames: array of alternative designations or null
fieldNotes.distMpc: adopted heliocentric distance (McConnachie distance modulus when matched and < 3 Mpc, else UNGC)
fieldNotes.distErrMpc: 1-sigma distance error from the distance-modulus error (null if not published)
fieldNotes.distMethod: distance method: UNGC codes (TRGB, Cep, geom, SN, SBF, mem, TF, FP, BS, CMD, HB, RR, PNLF, h, h', txt) or RSP = resolved stellar populations (McConnachie 2012 note 7)
fieldNotes.distQuality: 1 = primary (stellar-population / geometric / SN / SBF / PNLF), 2 = secondary (TF, FP, BS, group membership) or flagged uncertain, 3 = velocity- or texture-based
fieldNotes.type: morphological T-type (UNGC de Vaucouleurs code, -3..11; dSph/dE typically -3..-1, Ir = 10); McConnachie-only rows mapped from their Hubble type
fieldNotes.morph: UNGC dwarf class + surface-brightness class (e.g. 'Sph L', 'Ir N') or McConnachie Hubble type
fieldNotes.MB: absolute B magnitude corrected for Galactic + internal extinction, at the adopted distance
fieldNotes.MV: absolute V magnitude from McConnachie 2012 (Local Group rows only)
fieldNotes.lum: preferred optical luminosity in band lumBand (McConnachie M_V when available, else UNGC M_B)
fieldNotes.logLK: Ks-band luminosity (UNGC, M_K,sun = 3.28), rescaled to the adopted distance
fieldNotes.diamKpc: Holmberg (26.5 B mag/arcsec^2) linear diameter, rescaled to the adopted distance
fieldNotes.ba: apparent axial ratio b/a (UNGC; McConnachie 1 - ellipticity for M12-only rows)
fieldNotes.paDeg: major-axis position angle, east of north, [0, 180): McConnachie 2012, else the 2MASS XSC super-coadd PA of the matching 2MRS galaxy; null elsewhere
fieldNotes.hrv: heliocentric radial velocity (McConnachie when matched, else UNGC)
fieldNotes.vLG: radial velocity in the Local Group frame (UNGC)
fieldNotes.tidalIndex: UNGC tidal index Theta_1 (> 0: member of the group of mainDisturber)
fieldNotes.mainDisturber: UNGC main disturber (the neighbour with the largest tidal influence)
fieldNotes.source: row provenance: UNGC, UNGC+M12 (UNGC row with McConnachie values applied) or M12
fieldNotes.derived: fields computed by this build rather than taken from the catalogs (MB, logLK, diamKpc) plus 'Kmag~B' when UNGC estimated Ks from B; null = all catalog values

excluded.reason: the Milky Way itself (modelled separately by the app)
